# Software requirements 

```{r lib, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

# 1. TCGA evaluation from CLAM

## Read in data

```{r}
TCGA_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/TCGA_KIRC/TCGA_KIRC_metadata_cleaned.csv")
```


```{r}
out <- list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/TCGA_KIRC/eval_results/train_b32_lr1low_svm_s1_TCGA_EVAL/")
out <- out[str_detect(out, "fold")]

results <- foreach(i = out, .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  results <- read_csv(paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/TCGA_KIRC/eval_results/train_b32_lr1low_svm_s1_TCGA_EVAL/", i))
  results$fold <- str_extract(i, "(\\d)+")
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
results$PID <- results$slide_id %>% 
  str_split("-", simplify = TRUE) %>% 
  .[, 1:3] %>% 
  apply(1, paste, collapse = "-")
```

```{r}
colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "p_0"] <- "TME_suppressed"
colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "p_1"] <- "TME_activated"
colnames(results)[colnames(results) == "p_2"] <- "TME_silent"

results <- results %>% pivot_longer(4:6, names_to = "TME_archetype", values_to = "prop") %>% dplyr::select(-"Y", -"Y_hat") 
```

## Process 

### All folds

```{r}
# Mean proportions across images per patient
results_folds <- results %>% group_by(TME_archetype, PID, fold) %>% mutate(prop = mean(prop)) %>% dplyr::select(PID, fold, TME_archetype, prop) %>% unique()
```

```{r}
results_out_folds <- results_folds %>% group_by(PID, TME_archetype) %>% mutate(mean = mean(prop)) %>% dplyr::select(PID, TME_archetype, mean) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% filter(mean == max(mean)) %>% unique()
```

### Selected fold

Here, we are selecting the best performing model fold (fold 0). 

```{r}
# Mean proportions across images per patient
results_selected <- results %>% filter(fold == "0") %>% group_by(TME_archetype, PID, fold) %>% mutate(prop = mean(prop)) %>% dplyr::select(PID, fold, TME_archetype, prop) %>% unique()
```

```{r}
results_out_selected <- results_selected %>% group_by(PID, TME_archetype) %>% mutate(mean = mean(prop)) %>% dplyr::select(PID, TME_archetype, mean) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% filter(mean == max(mean)) %>% unique()
```


## Visualization 

```{r}
ggplot(results_out_folds, aes(x = TME_archetype, y = mean))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = TME_archetype), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values =c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(results_out_selected, aes(x = TME_archetype, y = mean))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = TME_archetype), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values =c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"))
```

## Survival analysis

```{r}
results_combined <- results_out_folds %>% dplyr::select(PID, TME_archetype) %>% transmute(TME_archetype_folds = TME_archetype)

results_combined$TME_archetype_selected <- results_out_selected$TME_archetype[match(results_combined$PID, results_out_selected$PID)]
```

```{r}
results_combined$status_OS <- TCGA_meta$status_OS[match(results_combined$PID, TCGA_meta$PID)]
results_combined$OS_days <- TCGA_meta$OS_days[match(results_combined$PID, TCGA_meta$PID)]
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact 
library(survival)
library(survminer)

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ TME_archetype_selected, data = results_combined)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv",
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          conf.int = FALSE)

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ TME_archetype_folds, data = results_combined)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv",
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          conf.int = FALSE)
```
```{r}
all <- results_combined %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(TME_archetype_folds, TME_archetype_selected)
alluvial_wide(all, 
              colorful_fill_variable_stratum = FALSE,
              col_vector_flow = c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"))+
  theme_classic()


library(jaccard)
jaccard(as.numeric(as.factor(results_combined$TME_archetype_folds)), as.numeric(as.factor(results_combined$TME_archetype_selected)))
```

## Save results

```{r}
write_csv(results_combined, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/TCGA_KIRC/TCGA_KIRC_eval_out.csv")
```
